examples.title: Interdependence of Spheres
examples.problem: How does water (Hydrosphere) reach the plants on land (Lithosphere)?
examples.solution: Evaporation (from Hydrosphere) -> Clouds in Atmosphere -> Rain falling on Lithosphere.
examples.explanation: All spheres of the Earth work together to support life in the Biosphere.

examples.title: The 3 Rs in Action
examples.problem: Give an example of 'Reuse' in your daily life.
examples.solution: Using an empty jam jar to store pulses or pens instead of throwing it away.
examples.explanation: Reuse helps reduce the amount of waste generated and saves resources.

examples.title: Global Warming simple model
examples.problem: Why is a car parked in the sun hotter inside than outside?
examples.solution: The glass lets sunlight in but traps the heat inside. This is similar to how certain gases trap heat on Earth.
examples.explanation: This is a simple model of the Greenhouse Effect.
